objective: Extend benchmark coverage with dedicated column-scan fast path metrics for recent SQL optimizations.

tasks.title: Benchmark column-scan fast path metrics
expected_changes: Add a benchmark section for narrow column-scan aggregate and DISTINCT workloads.
Cover COUNT(column), COUNT(DISTINCT ... WHERE ...), DISTINCT ... WHERE ..., MIN/MAX, STRING_AGG, and GROUP_CONCAT.
Keep data setup unchanged by reusing existing benchmark tables.
